Source:

Description

TLP Receive CSR (PCIe link --> CPU). An incoming TLP is captured as it is: the 3 header DWORDs here, DW3 in rx.data and, from DW3 on, every DWORD in rx_payload. The firmware decodes them, then clears rx.valid to take the next TLP.

Contents

Offset Identifier Name
0x00 header0 csr.rx.header0
0x04 header1 csr.rx.header1
0x08 header2 csr.rx.header2
0x0C data csr.rx.data
0x10 valid csr.rx.valid
